title: collapseThreads=true loads all matching emails into memory
description: email.rs:192-196: when collapseThreads=true the handler calls query_objects with no limit (fetches all matching IDs), then get_objects with all those IDs. For an account with 10M emails this is an unbounded in-memory allocation. A hostile client can trigger OOM by sending Email/query with collapseThreads=true against a large account. Fix: add a server-enforced ceiling on the uncollapsed result set size and return tooManyChanges or paginate the collapse internally.
